articles.title: Robot maker Unitree is going public. Hyperliquid traders see 4x upside from IPO price
articles.snippet: Hyperliquid traders value Unitree at nearly $38 billion versus $9 billion at its IPO, leaving leveraged bets vulnerable when trading begins, Allium analysts said.

articles.title: Paul Tudor Jones’ investment firm increases stake in BlackRock's bitcoin ETF after year of selling
articles.snippet: Calls fell 85.2% to 148,000 underlying shares, while puts slipped 1.4% to 715,000.

articles.title: Trump expected to attend White House meeting with crypto CEOs, sources say
articles.snippet: Those involved in a meeting of CEOs from the worlds of crypto, prediction markets and AI anticipate President Donald Trump will take part in next week's gathering.

articles.title: DefiLlama delayed mobile launch over phishing apps on Apple Store, founder says
articles.snippet: DefiLlama’s founder said Apple removed one fake app within days after the company documented it draining funds from a small crypto wallet.

articles.title: Galaxy lowers CLARITY Act odds to 10%
articles.snippet: Galaxy cited unresolved ethics, stablecoin yield and developer protection issues, along with a narrow Senate window when lawmakers return in September.
